blocks.text: More Coquitlam real estate
Summitt View: streets and boundaries

items.t: The City's Northwest Burke Vision states the Burke area's north-south access is provided by Coast Meridian Road and Pipeline Road, with David Avenue and Victoria Drive as the important east-west arterials.
Westwood Plateau is the planned area to the west of the Burke lands, and the Coquitlam River escarpment bisects the western portion of the Northwest Burke Vision area.

blocks.text: Summitt View: the housing stock

items.t: The City plans this side of northeast Coquitlam for family-oriented neighbourhoods with a mix of housing: the Northwest Burke Vision land use pattern shows single family and townhousing mix, and single family, townhousing and apartment mix, areas.

blocks.text: Summitt View: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The whole city is covered by the Interim Official Community Plan (OCP), Bylaw No. 5511, 2026, adopted April 27, 2026, which carries four development permit areas: Urban Design, Watercourse Protection, Wildfire Hazard and Unstable Slopes.

Northeast Coquitlam has the wider creek rule: a Watercourse Protection Development Permit is required before altering land within 50 metres of the top of bank of any watercourse — the rest of Coquitlam uses 30 metres.

City-wide Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH) rules fall under zoning Bylaw No. 3000, 1996. The local trigger here is the one the City flags: a creek or a steep slope on or next to the lot means contacting Development Services before designing.

The Northwest Burke Vision names the watercourses buyers on this slope meet by name: the Coquitlam River, Hyde Creek, Smiling Creek and Burke Mountain Creek, each with Streamside Protection and Enhancement Area setbacks.

blocks.text: Summitt View: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The Burke Mountain Middle/Secondary School is being built off David Avenue just east of Coast Meridian Road, which will change school trips for the whole lower Burke slope when it opens; SD43 stated the project was approximately 70 percent complete in August 2026.
The Northwest Burke Vision plans improved access to Pinecone Burke Provincial Park from this side of the city, as a planning direction rather than a built road.
The Coquitlam River floodplain sits at the foot of this slope in the Vision's mapping, even though the house streets are upland — the flood check and the creek check are two different lookups here.

blocks.text: Summitt View: development and new projects

items.t: Burke Mountain Middle/Secondary School, off David Avenue just east of Coast Meridian Road, SD43 with the City as school and park site partner, combined middle and secondary school: SD43 states the project was approximately 70 percent complete in August 2026, with roadway, grass field and building work continuing — status: under construction (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: Summitt View: getting around

items.t: Route 186, Coquitlam Central Station to Hampton Park, runs the David Avenue corridor via Pinetree Way, Pipeline Road and Robson Drive.
Route 187 connects the Johnson Street and Westwood Plateau side to Coquitlam Central Station via Plateau Boulevard, Paddock Drive and Parkway Boulevard, west of this pocket.
David Avenue is the east-west arterial out of the pocket, and Coast Meridian Road is the north-south arterial, per the City's Burke planning documents.

blocks.text: Summitt View: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the Watercourse Protection layer first: the 50-metre Northeast Coquitlam permit area is wider than the city norm, and the permit guide does not itself set the final setback for a specific lot.

Check the Unstable Slopes and Wildfire Hazard maps in Interim OCP Schedule G and the environmental Schedule B mapping, which maps steep slopes and the interface wildfire boundary; neither gives a lot-level geotechnical conclusion.
Check the Coquitlam River floodplain mapping for any lot at the foot of the slope, separately from the creek permit check.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Summitt View?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 3 houses listed in Summitt View. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Summitt View a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 33% on only 3 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Summitt View from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses and 0 condos and townhomes sold in Summitt View over those 5 months; detached houses peaked in July with 1 sold.

faq.q: How big is Summitt View compared with the rest of Coquitlam?
faq.a: In October 2026, Summitt View held 0.8% of the 378 detached houses listed in Coquitlam.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Summitt View than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 4 in June to 3 in October 2026 (−25.0%).

faq.q: Is Summit Middle School in this pocket, and what is its address?
faq.a: Summit Middle School is an SD43 school at 1450 Parkway Boulevard, on Westwood Plateau — not at a Summit Drive address, and not on Burke Mountain.

By bus to Coquitlam Central Station, because there is no rapid transit on this slope. TransLink route 186 runs David Avenue via Pinetree Way, Pipeline Road and Robson Drive between Coquitlam Central Station and Hampton Park, which is the David Avenue corridor service for the lower Burke Mountain streets.

faq.q: Does a creek setback change what I can build?
faq.a: Yes, if the lot is close enough to a watercourse. In Northeast Coquitlam the Watercourse Protection Development Permit Area extends 50 metres from the top of bank of any watercourse, and altering land inside it needs the permit first, with conditions for riparian protection and slope stability. Hyde Creek, Smiling Creek and Burke Mountain Creek all cross this slope, so measure the lot against the creek map first.
